title: Full-Value Portion for Recently Settled Estates — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Estate Terms
content:
# Full-Value Portion for Recently Settled Estates

**Estate terms — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), later distribution-margin allocations retired for an estate.**

An estate settled recently keeps part of a later distribution-margin row at full value:

- where the estate's request was approved by the board no more than **6** full calendar months before the retirement, **20 percent (0.2)** of the gross is paid at full value;
- where it was approved more than 6 and no more than **12** full calendar months before, **10 percent (0.1)** of the gross is paid at full value;
- an older approval leaves no part at full value.

The discount acts only on the rest of the gross; the row's payable consists of the full-value part together with the discounted rest.

**Approval age** is read from the estate retirement request: the full calendar months from its board approval date to the date the row is retired for the estate.

## Approval age and full-value part

| Full calendar months since board approval | Part of the gross at full value |
|---|---|
| 0 to 6 | 20 percent |
| 7 to 12 | 10 percent |
| 13 or more | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, board approval on 2026-02-17)

| Retired on | Full months since approval | Part at full value |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-17 | 6 | 20 percent |
| 2026-09-16 | 6 | 20 percent |
| 2026-09-17 | 7 | 10 percent |
| 2027-02-17 | 12 | 10 percent |
| 2027-03-17 | 13 | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical discount)

Gross $500.00, approval 4 full months earlier, and a discount that leaves 0.60 of value on the rest: the full-value part is 20 percent of $500.00, $100.00; the rest, $400.00, is worth $240.00 after the discount; the row is paid $100.00 together with $240.00, a total of $340.00.
